name: M7b - conflict detect + plain-language surface
goal: Classify a paused-conflict integration rebase per-file into the M7a taxonomy and surface the conflicts in plain language, replacing the raw unmerged-paths throw - while the verb still refuses/pauses (no apply, no landing change).

tasks.name: classifyRebaseConflicts + the conflicts payload
tasks.description: Add a READ-ONLY classifyRebaseConflicts(worktree) that maps each unmerged path's git status --porcelain conflict code (UU=overlap, AA=add-add, UD/DU=delete-modify; binary via numstat -/- takes precedence) to an M7a class + a plain-language two-sided summary, and add an optional conflicts?: Array<{path, conflictClass, summary}> field to FinalizationResult (integration.ts:36-52). READ-ONLY: the stage reads git show :2:/:3: are wrapped in try/catch returning 0 for an absent stage (a delete/modify side) so a taxonomy-required class never crashes the classifier. Wires into no path yet (Task 2 does).

steps.description: RED: In integration-cases.ts add SIX classifier tests; each conflict test seeds a paused conflicted rebase by mirroring seedConflictMidRebase (:182-194) - advance root main with a target-side change, stage the worktree-side change, then expect(() => finalizeCommanderLocalCommit(database, commanderInput(root, assignment, 'conflict'))).toThrow() leaves the paused conflicted rebase; import classifyRebaseConflicts from ../integration.js. (1) overlap: seedConflictMidRebase() (README.md both-modified) -> one entry {path:'README.md', conflictClass:'overlap'}, non-empty summary. (2) delete-modify (the crash falsifier for the stage guard): target commits README.md='target'; worktree stages a DELETE git(wt,'rm','README.md') instead of an edit -> assert one entry path:'README.md', conflictClass:'delete-modify' (do NOT pin UD vs DU), non-empty summary, and the call did NOT throw. (3) add-add: target commits NEW.md='target'; worktree writes+stages NEW.md='source' -> conflictClass:'add-add'. (4) binary: both sides add the same NEW path with DIFFERING binary blobs (writeFileSync Buffer.from([...]) vs a different byte run) -> numstat -/- -> conflictClass:'binary'. (5) rename-modify: worktree git(wt,'mv','README.md','RENAMED.md') + edit; target modifies README.md -> assert only: >=1 entry surfaced, its conflictClass is a member of the taxonomy union, non-empty summary, and no throw. (6) empty: fresh setup(false) worktree -> [].

GREEN: integration.ts add conflicts?: Array<{path:string; conflictClass:'overlap'|'add-add'|'delete-modify'|'binary'|'other'; summary:string}> to FinalizationResult after detail? (:51). Add exported READ-ONLY classifyRebaseConflicts(worktree): unmerged = runGit(worktree,['diff','--name-only','--diff-filter=U']).trim(); if empty return []; for each path: xy = runGit(worktree,['status','--porcelain=v1','--',path]).slice(0,2); binary = /^-\t-\t/.test(runGit(worktree,['diff','--numstat','--',path]).trim()); conflictClass = binary?'binary': xy==='UU'?'overlap': xy==='AA'?'add-add': (xy==='UD'||xy==='DU')?'delete-modify':'other'; const stageLines = (stage:2|3):number => { try { return runGit(worktree,['show',`:${stage}:${path}`]).split('\n').length; } catch { return 0; } }; const ours = stageLines(2); const theirs = stageLines(3); summary names both sides + the class; return {path, conflictClass, summary}. The stageLines try/catch is MANDATORY (a delete/modify absent stage otherwise throws).

steps.expected: all pass (baseline 291 + 6 new classifier tests; no path wired).
